parsed.answer: I couldn't find a past ticket reporting this problem, which is that in NAT mode, after wsl --shutdown, Windows can reach a WSL service through localhost (::1) but not through 127.0.0.1. The tickets I did find are about other problems. WSL#40688 is about NAT mode having no outbound connectivity. WSL#10561 is about the 127.0.0.42 nameserver under DNS tunneling. WSL#11468 and WSL#10494 are about port forwarding failing for containers in mirrored mode. WSL#14063 is about 127.0.0.1 policy routing inside the distro in mirrored mode. None of them covers IPv4 loopback forwarding failing while IPv6 works in NAT mode, so I can't give a confirmed fix from the archive. In the meantime, you could connect to the service through localhost (::1), which already works for you. If you need an IPv4 address, you could try the WSL VM's eth0 address. Please also file this as a new issue and attach logs from collect-wsl-logs.ps1 with the networking profile.
